name: Tailwind
description: Autocompletion for Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes and variants.

configWorkspace.title: Custom theme entry CSS file
configWorkspace.description: Path to the CSS file containing your project's @theme/@utility customizations (e.g. src/app.css). Local @import statements from this file are followed too. Leave blank to use only Tailwind's default theme.

configWorkspace.title: Suppress default Tailwind colors
configWorkspace.description: Only show colors defined in your own theme CSS's @theme block — hides Tailwind's default color palette (red, blue, grey, etc.) from completions entirely. Has no effect unless a custom theme entry CSS file is set above.
